caption: The Smithsonian Institution, The 1900 Solar Eclipse Expedition of the Astrophysical Observatory (1900/1904)
alt: A photograph of the eclipsed Sun’s edge: the dark curve of the Moon across the lower half, with pale, flame-like prominences and a soft glow rising from its rim into a black sky, marked 230° and 270°.
bibliography: Smithsonian Institution. The 1900 Solar Eclipse Expedition of the Astrophysical Observatory. Smithsonian Institution, 1904.
